note:
Close-up smiling faces for the REVIEWS page hero, replacing the hands-and-pipette shot currently there (skingenetix-reviews-page-banner.jpg, 1920x1080).

MEASURED GEOMETRY, NOT ASSUMED. The section is Impact's image-with-text-overlay, class `content-over-media--sm`, `full-bleed`. Read off the live theme.css: --content-over-media-height is 375px / 400px / 440px at the <700 / >=700 / >=1400 breakpoints, object-fit cover, object-position center. So the box is a FIXED PIXEL HEIGHT across a 100vw width - not an aspect ratio - exactly as recorded in ADR-005. Overlay is rgb(26 26 26 / 0.4) and the text is CENTRED, white, max-width 780px.

WHY 3:1 AND NOT THE 4.41:1 TARGET. The eventual master wants ~4.41:1 to fill 1920x440. Only Seedream reaches that, and gpt-image HARD-REFUSES anything past 3:1 with a 400 - so briefing the final width here would silently drop a supplier and break rule 1. This is a CHOICE round: every supplier runs at 3:1 (gpt-image lands at 2048x688, 2.98:1; NBP snaps to 21:9; Luma to 16:9), Malcolm picks the frame, and the winner is widened afterwards. Widening is safe for this brief specifically because the non-face side is featureless graphite - the case where extend-banner-canvas.py works, unlike the limb-to-edge smear that failed on 2026-08-24.

COMPOSITION IS DRIVEN BY THE CROP, TWICE OVER. At 3:1 in a 1920x440 box the theme scales by width and keeps only the middle 68.75% of the master's height, so the face must sit inside the middle two thirds vertically or the forehead and chin are cut. Horizontally the centred text occupies the middle 1248px of the master, so the face is placed in the outer third - left in four slots, right in four - and the side the text crosses is held even in tone.

MOBILE IS NOT SOLVED BY THIS SET AND MUST NOT BE ASSUMED TO BE. At 390x375 the box shows only the middle ~35% of a 3:1 master - which is the text zone. An off-centre face is cropped out of frame entirely on a phone. The section carries a separate mobile_image slot and that is the correct fix; a mobile companion is generated once a winner is chosen. Do not judge these frames on a phone and do not publish one without the mobile slot filled.

SMILE SPLIT. Malcolm asked for both registers, 2026-08-25. SMILE1-4 are closed-lip Mona Lisa; SMILE5-8 are warm and open with teeth. The framings and gaze directions are deliberately mirrored across the two halves so the smile is the only variable between them. Ages 30-45, stated per slot because engines default to about 25 when left to choose.

SUPPLIER REALITY. Seedream refused the reclining bare-skin briefs every time, but this subject is a clothed head-and-shoulders close-up, which is a different content question - it is expected to pass and is the only route to the final width, so read its slots first. FLUX.2 is safe here: no branding is legible anywhere in frame.

slots.title: Mona Lisa - three-quarter turn, face right third, eyes to camera
slots.prompt: Extreme close-up fine-art beauty photograph of one woman about thirty eight years old, of Northern European appearance with fair skin, in a very wide cinematic frame three times wider than it is tall. Her head and the tops of her shoulders occupy the right third of the frame, turned three quarters toward the camera. Her eyes look directly into the lens, calm and warm. Her lips are closed and the corners are just lifted in a faint, private, knowing smile - the warmth is carried by a soft crease at the outer corner of each eye rather than by the mouth. Her head reaches about three quarters of the frame height and sits clear of both the top and the bottom edge, with dark air above her hair and below her shoulders. To the left of her, filling the entire left two thirds of the frame and running to the left edge, the top edge and the bottom edge, is a deep graphite grey ground, colour #1A1A1A, dark, smooth and even in tone with no hard edge, object or bright highlight anywhere in it. One soft directional light from the upper right models the cheekbone, the bridge of the nose and the jaw, letting the far side of the face fall gently into shadow. Skin is real and finely textured with visible pores, fine down catching the light, and the faint natural lines at the eyes and mouth present and lit rather than erased. Hair is dark and softly lit, falling behind the shoulder. Very shallow depth of field, fine film grain, sculptural, quiet and premium.
